verified.socioeconomic_finding: NO socioeconomic / joint-venture / ownership flag mutates materially in the IDV/G cell. Matrix agrees exactly (business_categories 0.049, organizational_type 0.047). Architecture implication: socioeconomic/ownership attributes can be carried on the award spine, not re-snapshotted per modification, for this cell.

No ownership/JV flag beyond the two composite descriptor columns reaches even 0.10, so the discrete socioeconomic status booleans do NOT re-represent in this cell.

Only two socioeconomic/ownership fields mutate materially in this cell, and both are already claimed by the matrix: business_categories at frac 0.68 (recomputed 0.68) and organizational_type at frac 0.15 (recomputed 0.15). business_categories is a composite rollup categorization field, not a statutory ownership flag. Every GRANULAR ownership/joint-venture/disadvantaged flag is near-zero and does NOT mutate meaningfully: woman_owned_business 0.10, foreign_owned_and_located 0.03, small_disadvantaged_busine 0.02, women_owned_small_business 0.02, and veteran_owned_business, minority_owned_business, all joint_venture_* (economically, women_owned), business_types, business_types_desc, and every race/ethnicity *_owned_* flag (alaskan_native, american_indian, black_american, hispanic_american, native_american, native_hawaiian, other_minority, tribally) all at 0.00. synthesis.blind_spot_summary: Across all 24 modeled (kind,action_type) cells the truly-blind >=0.3 mutations partition cleanly into four disjoint classes, none of which is a socioeconomic status flag. (1) Derived twins of on-spine fields — generated_pragmatic_obligation (blind, but the derived double-twin of on-spine federal_action_obligation at an identical frac in every cell) and the *_desc description twins of codes the spine already carries (contracting_officers_desc twins contracting_officers_deter; type_of_contract_pric_desc, contract_award_type_desc, commercial_item_acqui_desc, type_of_idc_description, sam_exception_description, a_76_fair_act_action_desc, program_system_or_equ_desc all twin on-spine code columns). These carry no information the spine lacks. (2) Per-award economics — period_of_perf_potential_e and potential_total_value_awar mutate >=0.30 under A,D,H,L,N,F,E,X,T,V and the option-adjacent supplemental actions; the spine carries only current end-date/current total value, so the potential (ceiling) figures are a genuine information loss on scope-increasing mods. (3) Entity-identity churn — under J (novation), V (vendor UEI change), W (address change), and T (transfer), a dense block of blind fields fires 0.32-0.72: legal_entity_address_line1, legal_entity_zip4/zip_last4, vendor_phone_number, vendor_fax_number, the full recipient_location_* geography ladder (state/county/congressional code+name+fips+population+zip5), parent_recipient_name_raw, parent_recipient_unique_id, recipient_unique_id, and (T only) awarding_office_code/name. (4) New-award enrichment metadata under N/F/E — foreign_funding plus the description twins above. Critically, in the entity-churn cells the on-spine recipient identity keys (recipient_uei, recipient_hash, recipient_name, parent_uei, parent_recipient_hash, cage_code, business_categories) ALSO mutate in lockstep, so the spine is NOT blind to the fact of an identity change — only to the granular blind address/geography/contact attributes hanging off it.
synthesis.socioeconomic_verdict: Definitive: NO. During option-year exercise (AWARD/G, IDV/G) and re-representation (AWARD/R, AWARD/P, IDV/R, IDV/P), socioeconomic / joint-venture / structural-ownership data does NOT mutate in the 261 dropped columns in any way the spine is blind to. Independent self-join recompute over the full 20-column socio class in the parquet: in AWARD/G the maximum socio mutation is organizational_type at 0.0617 and business_categories at 0.0446 — every discrete ownership/JV boolean (woman_owned_business, veteran_owned_business, minority_owned_business, small_disadvantaged_busine, women_owned_small_business, all joint_venture_*, all race/ethnicity *_owned_*) is <=0.009, three-plus orders of magnitude below the 0.30 material-mutation bar. IDV/G max socio frac 0.0487. The two fields that DO churn under re-representation — business_categories (0.62 in AWARD/R, 0.68 in AWARD/P, 0.83 in IDV/R) and organizational_type (0.15-0.24) — must be distinguished sharply: business_categories is a composite rollup and is ON the spine (§3 line 161, direct), so it is fully observed; the spine is not blind to it. organizational_type and corporate_entity_not_tax_e ARE blind (§6, not carried), but they mutate only 0.15-0.25 (conditional band) and are IRS/SAM structural-classification descriptors, NOT statutory set-aside eligibility. The individual statutory socioeconomic booleans are award-invariant across G/R/P: they stay pinned to the base award and never approach the mutation threshold. Re-representation rewrites the coarse business_categories rollup (observed on spine) and, secondarily, the blind organizational_type/corporate_entity structural class — it does NOT flip the granular set-aside/ownership/JV certification flags. Any design that re-materializes granular socioeconomic flags per-modification for G/R/P is over-engineering against 1-2-row noise.
synthesis.recommendation: Hybrid: targeted spine expansion for per-award economics + a separate Lance Entity Dimension for identity attributes. Do NOT status-quo (two genuine blind spots persist) and do NOT bulk-expand the spine to absorb all 261 dropped columns. Specifically: (A) EXPAND THE 131-COL SPINE by exactly two columns — period_of_performance_potential_end_date (blind twin period_of_perf_potential_e) and potential_total_value_of_award (blind twin potential_total_value_awar). These are per-award economic ceilings that mutate >=0.30 under the high-volume scope-change actions (A 26.7k, D 63.2k, plus H/L/N/F/E/X/V), are award-scoped (not entity-scoped), and have no on-spine surrogate — the spine already carries the current-end/current-value pair but silently drops the potential/ceiling pair, so a scope-increase modification is invisible in ceiling terms. Adding them closes the only substantive award-level blind spot and each gets a value column, no new index needed. (B) BUILD A SEPARATE LANCE ENTITY DIMENSION keyed on recipient_uei/recipient_hash (BTREE) for the entity-identity churn surfaced by J (novation, 1073), V (UEI change, 922), W (address change, 1251), T (transfer, 97), and IDV/J (526): legal_entity_address_line1, legal_entity_zip4, legal_entity_zip_last4, vendor_phone_number, vendor_fax_number, the recipient_location_* geography ladder (state/county/congressional code+name+fips+population+zip5), parent_recipient_name_raw, parent_recipient_unique_id, recipient_unique_id, plus organizational_type and corporate_entity_not_tax_e. These are slowly-changing entity attributes that churn only on identity-boundary actions, not per-transaction; they belong in an entity dimension resolved by UEI, versioned as an SCD, NOT re-snapshotted onto every one of 3.2M transaction rows. The spine already carries the entity resolution keys (recipient_uei/hash, parent_uei/hash, cage_code) that mutate in lockstep on these actions, so the spine records THAT the entity changed and the dimension carries WHAT changed — clean separation. (C) DO NOT carry the granular socioeconomic/JV booleans anywhere mutable: they are award-stable across every action type (max 0.06) and stay on the base-award spine snapshot. (D) The remaining blind >=0.3 fields are non-substantive twins (generated_pragmatic_obligation duplicates federal_action_obligation; every *_desc twins an on-spine code) — carry neither; reconstruct on read from the on-spine code/value.
caveats: Single-agency sample: entire matrix is Air Force (agency 5700), ~3.2M rows. Mutation fractions — especially the entity-churn geography block and the potential-value cells — may not generalize to civilian agencies with different novation/address-change base rates. Validate against a second agency before hard-committing the schema.

Thin cells: AWARD/R (88 transitions) and AWARD/P (59) are statistically fragile — a single row moves frac by ~0.011-0.017, so any 0.15-0.30 conditional-band column in R/P is within noise of the threshold. IDV/P (35) and IDV/T/E (26 each) and AWARD/T (97) are similarly thin; treat their exact fracs as directional, not precise.

Non-standard action_type 'Y' (AWARD 24 / IDV 24 transitions) is outside the FPDS standard code set and was excluded from the modeled blueprint per the coverage spec; it is low-volume but undiagnosed — its footprint is unverified.

generated_pragmatic_obligation is reported as a blind >=0.3 mutation in most AWARD cells but is the derived double-twin of on-spine federal_action_obligation (identical frac in every cell); it and the *_desc description-twins are information-free relative to the spine and should not drive any add-column decision.

IDV/M and IDV/B were modeled from the full matrix (not in the verified self-join set); their footprints are matrix-only, not independently recomputed — though the AWARD/IDV cells that WERE cross-checked showed matrix-vs-recompute agreement to within 0.01, so confidence in the matrix fracs is high.

The matrix's own 'projected' flag is the build's projection intent, not 131-col spine membership; on_spine/blind classification here was resolved against docs/reference/FPDS_CANONICAL_FIELD_DICTIONARY.md (§3 spine, §6 BULK-native-not-carried), not the matrix flag. A handful of matrix-tracked columns marked projected=True are emitted in zero cells (internal emit gap, e.g. last_modified_date, transaction_unique_id) — a matrix-build defect noted in the IDV/G and AWARD/J discrepancies, orthogonal to the architecture decision.
